options.name: Beauty Mark (Mole) | 60 min
options.description:
This procedure involves creating an artificial beauty mark to enhance facial charm. The impression can change depending on the location, with popular areas being around the mouth, under the eyes, and on the nose bridge.
Duration: 60 minutes
Effect lasts: 1–3 years
Recommended for: Those who want to add a focal point to their face, create a more attractive image, or get a symbolic mark (like a fortune mole) in a specific area
Precautions: The placement can significantly affect your impression, so a thorough consultation is necessary. Temporary redness may occur after the procedure.

options.name: Natural Eyebrows | 60 min
options.description:
This style enhances your natural brow texture by drawing each strand individually using a meticulous hand-drawn technique.
Duration: 60 minutes
Effect lasts: 1–1.5 years
Recommended for: Those with sparse or uneven brows, those who prefer a natural look, or those who find daily brow makeup bothersome
Precautions: Results may vary depending on skin type (e.g. oily skin). Avoid water, sweat, and UV exposure for about a week after the procedure.

options.name: Shadow Eyebrows | 60 min
options.description:
This technique adds soft shading to the brows, creating a gentle, shadow-like effect that enhances definition. It blends into the skin, making the overall shape of the brows appear more defined.
Duration: 60 minutes
Effect lasts: 1.5–2 years
Recommended for: Those with light or faint brows, those who want defined yet soft-looking brows, or those who want long-lasting makeup results
Precautions: Swelling or itchiness may occur after the procedure. Use sunscreen during the retention period for better results.

options.name: Combo Eyebrows | 70 min
options.description:
This style combines natural hair-stroke (texture) and shadow (shading) techniques to create brows that are both detailed and defined. It gives a clear yet natural impression.
Duration: 60 minutes
Effect lasts: 1.5–2 years
Recommended for: Those who want clearly shaped yet natural-looking brows, want both texture and shading, or frequently do eyebrow makeup
Precautions: Do not pick at scabs or peeling skin. Avoid alcohol, exercise, saunas on the day of the procedure, and stay away from harsh cleansers or exfoliators.

options.name: Eyeline | 60 min
options.description:
This procedure enhances the eyes by filling in the gaps between the lashes, making the eyes look bigger and more defined.
Duration: 60 minutes
Effect lasts: 2–3 years
Recommended for: Those with sparse lashes, those who want naturally defined eyes without makeup, or those who find daily eyeliner application inconvenient
Precautions: You may feel slight irritation or swelling after the procedure, but it usually subsides within 1–2 days.

options.name: Hairline | 70 min
options.description:
This procedure mimics the look of natural hair along the forehead line, ideal for those concerned about a wide or M-shaped forehead.
Duration: 60 minutes
Effect lasts: 2–3 years
Recommended for: Those with a wide or uneven forehead, those who rely on bangs to balance their face shape, or those who want a more defined hairline
Precautions: Gently shampoo without irritation when washing your hair. Some fading and flaking are normal and can be corrected with a follow-up session.

options.name: Lips | 60 min
options.description:
This procedure enhances pale or undefined lips by filling in the lip line and overall color with a natural shade, creating a more lively and vibrant look.
Duration: 60 minutes
Recommended for: Those with dull or uneven lip color, unclear lip contours, or who want a fresh look without lipstick
Precautions: Swelling or overly intense color may occur temporarily after the procedure. Do not rub off peeling skin, and apply lip balm regularly to keep lips hydrated.
